name: DESTOROYAH
about: The C example DESTOROYAH rebuilt in blocks and taken deeper (PAD-658): 50 Top spinner spins start it (100 the second time, 150 the third). Three stages: THE SWARM (three waves of aggregates advance from the Powerlines to the ramps and loop to the close targets, 10 s at each, a kill paying more the closer it is, each cleared wave into the pot; the title and line name where they are), his FLYING FORM (four hits in 40 s where he flies over the ramps and the Big loop, moving on every 10 s), then his PERFECT FORM (three Building hits in 40 s, the super jackpot every kill and the pot twice over). Cash the pot out at the right scoop once the swarm is beaten.
lost: No randomness in blocks: each aggregate's next shot is dealt in turn from a counter that runs all game (the far ring left, center, right, the near ring and the close ring likewise, skipping the shot the other aggregate stands on), where the C picked one at random; the flying form flies over the Left ramp, the Big loop and the Right ramp in that order. A player who learns the order can wait for it.
Aggregates come to the shield targets at once: the C sent none there until the shield platform had turned to face the player (or ever, with the shields fixed away).

The flying and perfect forms' seconds are a counter (SECONDS, TO STOP HIM), not the badge (the blocks' badge counts the mode's clock, and this mode has none): the Building's blink still quickens as they run out.
The counters show bare numbers: WAVE 2 over the kills to go where the C showed the wave as 2/3 and the kills as 1/4, and no counter says what the wave has paid so far.

The line does not say the wave or the kills (the WAVE counter does): in the swarm the title names the first aggregate's shot and the line the second's (SHOOT THE MASER TARGET / OR THE LEFT POWERLINE), where the C's line said WAVE 2: 3 MORE  -  CLOSER PAYS MORE and its lit shots alone said where they were.

An aggregate stands 10 s at each shot and the flying form moves on every 10 s, the same each time he comes back (PAD-658: a moving target stays 10 s at least), where the C's advanced every 7, 6 and 5 s, faster each time, and its flying form moved on every 3 s; its flying and perfect forms' clocks were 30 and 25 s.

No KILLS gauge: on the glass its pips sat over the game's own POWER widget at the right edge (the C showed as many pips as the wave needs, shaded yellow to red); the kills to go are on the WAVE counter.
A kill's clip plays at most once in each 4 s window of the mode's own (a block's every 4 seconds): the C waited 4 s from the last one it played.
An aggregate that would advance onto the other's shot takes the next one in turn: the C waited half a second and tried again.
The ending (DESTOROYAH DEFEATED, DESTOROYAH WITHDRAWS or DESTOROYAH WINS, its line and the total) stays up 3 s, the runtime's: the C kept it 10 s, with the kills and the wave in its line.
No debounce: the C counted the same target once in 250 ms; the blocks count every report.
A hit no longer answers by itself: the C flashed every kill's inserts white and played the game's climbing orchestra hit (PAD-415).
Its ending call plays after one of the game's own modes ends it too (the C kept quiet then, as it does for a drain or a tilt).
On Godzilla Pro the close ring's middle shield is the Mecha lane (the Pro has two fixed shields): the C dealt aggregates to the Pro's two shields only.

then.text: THE CLOSER IT IS, THE MORE IT PAYS

intro.what: Crab-like juvenile Destoroyahs crawl up out of the smoking ground by the waterfront in daylight, 0:59:36.

loop.what: SDF tanks and trucks draw up in a field below an elevated expressway to face the aggregates, one calm shot, 0:59:13.

kill.what: A juvenile Destoroyah beside a building is hit by the SDF freezer beam and bursts in blue light, sparks and smoke, 1:01:44.

escape.what: A juvenile Destoroyah, struck by sparks, rears up and lunges toward a yellow SDF vehicle in the foreground, 1:00:37.

wave.what: A glittering red swarm of aggregates converges and the giant aggregate form of Destoroyah takes shape out of it, 1:09:11.

boss.what: The perfect form of Destoroyah in close-up, eye glowing and jaws open, roars through blue mist, 1:24:07.

won.what: Destoroyah crashes down in a burst of sparks and lies sprawled on the ground, wings crumpled, 1:32:20.

lost.what: A run of shots: Destoroyah's purple micro-oxygen beam strikes Godzilla in a shower of sparks and he disappears in a fiery explosion, 1:20:54.

fly.what: A run of shots: the flying form of Destoroyah flies between the towers over the city, then swoops toward the camera with its red wings spread, 1:08:34.

wing.what: A run of shots: Godzilla Junior's blue ray strikes the flying form of Destoroyah in a burst of red fire and it drops out of the sky in front of a factory, 1:12:12.

cashout.what: A run of shots: the Super X3 fires its crackling blue freezing beam and Destoroyah sinks away into the night sky wrapped in a cloud of icy white mist, 1:35:10.

music.what: Ifukube's pounding brass battle music as the flying form of Destoroyah attacks the city and crowds flee, 1:06:42.

kill.what: A sharp explosion bursts against a juvenile Destoroyah in the night street, 0:38:42.

escape.what: A juvenile Destoroyah shrieks in close-up, horns crackling with lightning, as it turns on the riot police, 0:35:11.

wave.what: Destoroyah roars in close-up at the airport, a harsh rasping cry, 1:21:35.

boss.what: The perfect form of Destoroyah screeches in close-up with its jaws wide open, 1:24:44.

won.what: A huge explosion engulfs Destoroyah as Godzilla's ray strikes it, 1:33:27.

lost.what: Godzilla cries out in pain, glowing and staggering, after Destoroyah's beam hits him, 1:21:29.

fly.what: The flying form of Destoroyah screeches as it swoops in, a falling, warbling cry over the rush of its flight, 1:08:38.

cashout.what: The Super X3 fires its freezing beam at Destoroyah, a long icy hiss that fades away, 1:35:10.

fly.what: Ifukube's driving battle ostinato under the end titles, the same music that drives Godzilla's fight with the perfect form, 1:40:57.
